briefdescription.para: Set the retrieval callback used by the FLARE active-retrieval loop.

detaileddescription.para: Set Retrieval Callback.

When set, detectWithActiveRetrieval() calls this function each time the current document set does not provide sufficient coverage and a reformulated sub-query is available. The callback must be thread-safe with respect to the surrounding context but does not need to be re-entrant.
Passing a default-constructed (empty) function disables dynamic retrieval; the FLARE loop will then exit after the initial document set check without attempting further searches.
